original_test_intent: Verify uncorrectable non-fatal Poisoned-TLP handling for every required PCIe slot at both endpoint and upstream root port, with correct AER attribution, bounded transaction impact and full device/link recovery without fatal SyncFlood.
original_method: Build physical-slot endpoint/upstream-port topology and device workload/dependency map; decode current AER Uncorrectable Error Severity and source masks rather than trusting `7EF6030`; capture link/AER/device state; approve a harmless transaction that consumes the poison; inject one endpoint or root-port target at a time; correlate exact Poisoned TLP status, severity, requester/source ID and process/I/O outcome; verify no fatal escalation or persistent link/device error; restore BIOS/HDT/AER state before another target.
manual_activity: The FAE maps every slot path, approves the non-destructive poison-consuming transaction and AER severity policy, executes one target at a time and owns driver/device/link recovery and state restoration.
required_inputs: Physical slot/device serial to endpoint and upstream root-port BDF map for all targets
Endpoint class/driver/workload, active I/O and safe transaction that consumes Poisoned TLP
AMD tool/spec version/hash/license and proof errortype 6 targets the intended end/root source
Decoded `7EF6030` value/format for root-port and device Uncorrectable Error Severity plus masks/DPC/SyncFlood policy
Expected AER status/source ID/severity, application or I/O outcome and no-fatal/link-health oracle
Exact supported OS, timeout, abort, OOB recovery and BIOS/HDT restoration
safety_requirements: Dedicated/quiesced target with OOB management independent of the tested device
Re-enumerate topology and verify serial/upstream path immediately before injection; never copy BDFs
Use only a disposable bounded transaction; do not poison production data or management/storage traffic
Inject one target only and abort on wrong source, fatal/DPC/SyncFlood escalation, driver reset outside plan, link loss or host reset
No automatic retry; preserve evidence and restore/diff severity/AER/SyncFlood/HDT settings
agent_execution_scope: Validate topology, dependency isolation, package semantics, AER severity and transaction oracle
Collect read-only PCIe config/AER, link, driver, process/I/O, OS/BMC and post-health evidence
Do not select BDF/transaction, change BIOS/HDT, inject, reset/rebind/retry, consume production data or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Approve per-slot endpoint/root-port targets and poison consumer
Approve severity/mask/DPC/SyncFlood policy and errortype semantics

command_applicability.command_recommendation: Substitute topology-verified BDFs, prepare one approved disposable transaction, inject errortype 6 separately at endpoint or root port and correlate precise AER status/source plus transaction and link recovery.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The two BDF examples, errortype 6, severity/SyncFlood settings, Poisoned-TLP note, slot 1~N and 30/120 minutes are preserved while unresolved target/consumer details remain gated.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Run one topology-mapped Poisoned-TLP injection against a disposable transaction and prove the expected non-fatal AER source/disposition plus complete device/link recovery.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds consumer transaction, source/requester correlation, register decoding, workload isolation, explicit non-fatal boundary and rollback.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Tool PASS and a generic UCE log cannot prove Poisoned-TLP delivery, non-fatal containment or slot 1~N coverage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Poison propagation may abort or corrupt I/O, reset a driver/device, trip DPC/SyncFlood or disconnect a critical endpoint.

project_override_considerations: If no safe consumer transaction exists for a device class, retain topology/injection coverage as pending rather than fabricating one. The literal BDFs may be examples only and must never override live enumeration.
expected_evidence: Exact identity and full slot/endpoint/root-port/dependency map
Approved disposable transaction and baseline link/device/driver health
One target's full injection and exact AER Poisoned-TLP source/status/severity record
Transaction outcome and no fatal/reset/persistent link degradation
Restored state, post-health and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Slot 1~N is represented by one hardcoded BDF pair. The source names Poisoned TLP but supplies no consuming transaction or exact AER/source oracle. Severity values `7EF6030` are not decoded/formatted, timeout is undefined, RHEL 2022 is ambiguous, and DeepSeek carries memory-specific language.

blocked_analysis.analysis: PCIe Poisoned-TLP UCE-nonfatal intent and two target types are clear. Engineering can supply mapping, consumer and oracle, so static review completes while execution is gated.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row 57 Wistron-System RAS-00777-V002: provide physical PCIe slot/serial-to-endpoint/root-port BDF coverage for slot 1~N and an isolated transaction that safely consumes Poisoned TLP; approve AMD tool/spec provenance and errortype=6 source semantics; decode/approve `7EF6030`, masks, DPC and SyncFlood policy; define exact AER status/severity/source-ID plus process/I/O/link recovery oracle, supported OS, timeout, aborts, OOB recovery and restoration.

review_improvement: Adds the missing poison consumer and precise non-fatal AER boundary, preventing a hardcoded BDF and generic error log from masquerading as end-to-end Poisoned-TLP coverage.
independent_technical_reasoning: A Poisoned TLP is meaningful only when the test identifies which transaction carries poison and where the error is reported; injecting a flag without a consumer may arm or record the mechanism without testing system handling. Endpoint and root-port injections can attribute errors differently, so source IDs and upstream topology must be captured separately. Non-fatal means the configured AER disposition should avoid fatal/DPC/SyncFlood behavior, not that device or workload impact is harmless.
